source_caption:
Six days after the premiere of Euphoria Season 3, the show has triggered significant backlash, with viewers divided over a five-year time jump that pivots from high school drama to a darker, more exploitative aesthetic. A focal point of this controversy is a scene featuring Sydney Sweeney’s character, Cassie Howard, which has been widely slammed online as a "humiliation ritual". 

Cassie (Sydney Sweeney) is heavily criticized for her storyline, in which she justifies selling adult -intimate fetish content online as a way to monetize and pay for her wedding with Nate (Jacob Elordi). Many viewers have slammed this arc as a "humiliation ritual,"and a form of "female degradation," with some critics describing it as a move toward "adult exploitation" rather than compelling drama. Critics and fans accused creator Sam Levinson of focusing on shock value, with a repulsive yet biting critique of the 2026 creator economy that has pushed the show to a franchise-low 57% on Rotten Tomatoes.

The tension is even higher behind the scenes. Zendaya has notably distanced herself from the show, removing her Executive Producer credit and refusing to promote the season alongside her co-stars. Between Jules’ "sugar baby" storyline and Cassie’s degradation, the show has shifted from a neon-soaked drama into a bleak, controversial reset that many believe has finally gone too far.

source_details.synopsis: Euphoria is an American psychological drama television series created and written by Sam Levinson for HBO. Based on the Israeli miniseries of the same name created by Ron Leshem, the series stars Zendaya as drug-addicted teenager Rue Bennett, who also serves as an unreliable narrator. The ensemble cast includes Maude Apatow, Angus Cloud, Eric Dane, Alexa Demie, Jacob Elordi, Barbie Ferreira, Nika King, Storm Reid, Hunter Schafer, Algee Smith, Sydney Sweeney, Colman Domingo, Javon "Wanna" Walton, and Austin Abrams.
